world.b: Al Jazeera's live coverage of the Iran war: The Houthis again target Riyadh, and the coalition says two missiles were intercepted.
world.title: Houthis again target Riyadh as coalition says two missiles intercepted

national.h: Hegseth fires Pentagon's top military planner
national.b: Army Lt. Gen. Brett Sylvia was removed as head of strategy, plans and policy on the Joint Chiefs of Staff, with no reason given, a defense official said.
national.title: Hegseth fires the Pentagon's top military planner even as Trump considers new Iran strikes

national.h: 'Star Trek' actor Patrick Stewart dies at 86
national.b: Best known as Captain Jean-Luc Picard and Professor Charles Xavier, Stewart spent more of his career onstage, from Macbeth to "Waiting for Godot."
national.title: Patrick Stewart, star of stage and 'Star Trek,' dies at 86

national.h: HHS official backed policy that could benefit her
national.b: ProPublica: Alicia Jackson praised HHS dropping "black box" warnings on hormone replacement therapy; disclosures show the policy could bring her financial benefits.
national.title: Top U.S. Health Official Backed a Medication Policy Shift That Benefited a Company She Has Stock In

politics.h: Alaska governor orders probe of Peltola campaign
politics.b: Gov. Dunleavy's order follows reporting that Peltola's campaign discussed recruiting a candidate with the same name as Sen. Dan Sullivan.

international.b: A drone strike on a car in the Maghazi refugee camp killed two Palestinians, as the Health Ministry called for the Rafah crossing to open for the sick and wounded.
international.title: Israeli strikes hit Gaza as Health Ministry urges Rafah opening

international.h: Prosecutors seek death sentence for Yoon
international.b: Special prosecutors renewed their demand at an appeal hearing at the Seoul High Court; the former president was sentenced to life in February for leading an insurrection.

international.h: Activists say settlers beat them in West Bank
international.b: Activist Adele Shoko said armed settlers attacked her, US journalist Jasper Nathaniel and activist Andrey X in Umm al-Khair, and that Nathaniel was then arrested.

international.h: Israel vote count ends with no majority
international.b: With more than 99 percent counted, Netanyahu's bloc held 53 of 120 Knesset seats and Gadi Eisenkot's opposition 48, both short of the 61 needed; Arab parties held 19.
international.title: Israel election result shows no overall majority as vote count complete

business.b: The deal, which could cut competition in grocery delivery, is expected to close by the end of 2027 or early 2028 if shareholders and regulators approve; Instacart's name and app will remain.
business.title: DoorDash offers $17 billion for Instacart in what would be big grocery delivery consolidation

business.b: Consumer prices rose 3.6% in September from a year earlier, up from 3.4% in August, the Commerce Department said, driven largely by gas prices.

business.h: ECB President Lagarde to step down early
business.b: Lagarde will leave on February 7, about nine months before her term ends, giving EU leaders time to pick a successor before the French presidential election.

business.h: AI boom pushes smartphone prices up
business.b: Memory chip shortages driven by AI data centers have pushed global phone prices up an average of 15%, Counterpoint Research reported.

business.h: US economy grew at 3.4% pace in third quarter
business.b: GDP growth from July through September was up from 2.2% in the spring, driven by consumer spending and AI investment, the Commerce Department said.

science.h: Seabirds may get jet lag, study finds
science.b: Manx shearwaters appear to become slightly disoriented on long Atlantic flights as their internal clocks fall out of sync with the sun, a study in Science found.
science.title: Even birds get jet lagged, study shows

sports.h: Bears trade for Titans DT Jeffery Simmons
sports.b: Tennessee agreed to send the four-time Pro Bowler to Chicago for first-round picks in 2027 and 2028 and a 2027 fourth-rounder.
sports.title: Bears agree to blockbuster trade for Titans DT Jeffery Simmons

sports.h: Brewers win first World Series title
sports.b: Jacob Misiorowski threw 5 2/3 scoreless innings and Milwaukee beat Tampa Bay 4-1 in Game 5; William Contreras was named World Series MVP.
Kansas City signed the former Ravens kicker to its practice squad; Baltimore released Tucker in May 2025 after allegations of sexual misconduct.

local.h: Nobody is enforcing NYC's $3 bus fare for now
local.b: Enforcement is on pause after a series of confrontations involving MTA agents, and the NYPD will not step in while the security force is suspended.
local.title: NYPD won't enforce NYC's bus fare while MTA security force is suspended

local.h: Garbage truck kills woman in Brooklyn
local.b: Siobhan Lynch, 30, was struck by a Department of Sanitation truck while crossing Bay Parkway at Cropsey Avenue Wednesday evening, the NYPD said.
local.title: Brooklyn woman hit and killed by garbage truck at Bay Parkway, NYPD says

localgood.h: SNAP users to get more for fresh produce
localgood.b: City Hall said New Yorkers on SNAP will receive more money through the Health Bucks program for farmers markets and farm stands next year.
localgood.title: New Yorkers enrolled in SNAP will get more money for fresh produce next year
